pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: console: Add weak method to notify about death Call weak method die_notify. The method should be overwritten in mainboard directory to signal that a fatal error had occurred. On boards that do share the same EC and where the EC is capable of controlling LEDs or a buzzer the method can be overwritten in EC directory instead. Tested on Lenovo T500. remote_address: Allow IPv6 and "ssh Hostname" aliases to be used Currently `cros deploy` uses IPv4 pings to detect whether the DUT is alive. But a DUT could have an IPv6 address, or the hostname might be an alias specified in ~/.ssh/config, ala: Host foobar Hostname 2001:db8::1234 in which case the IPv4 ping would fail. Update the script to handle these cases. BUG=b:30405549 TEST=`cros deploy --debug "ssh://[2001:db8::1234]" shill` TEST=`cros deploy --debug 1.2.3.4 shill` TEST=`cros deploy --debug some_ssh_hostname shill` Change-Id: I61aa7fa1ada56f00547dc14a3859b4329d5d9648 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/599033 Commit-Ready: Kevin Cernekee <cernekee@chromium.org> Tested-by: Kevin Cernekee <cernekee@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>

login: Migrate kRemoveOldArcDataImpulse to ASYNC The impulse doesn't really need the synchronous behavior. Since the dependent job in /etc/init, arc-stale-directory-remover.conf, does not use pre-start (blocking) stanza, the job is started asynchronously even with SYNC anyway. Support for per model per test suite execution Unified bulids are currently testing all hw test suites for all models. Due to flakiness, time, and h/w constraints, this is potentially excessive. GoldenEye now has support to set which test suites should be executed on a per model basis and this updates CBuildBot to respect these settings and only execute the specified suites on the specified models. This is only used for the release builder since the other builders use different hardcoded configs to determine which suites should be run. BUG=b:64142091 TEST=builders/simple_builders_unittest && ./chromeos_config_unittest && stages/release_stages_unittest Change-Id: I45839b44fff9da8dbefae36453aff85b27e197a2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/611007 Commit-Ready: C Shapiro <shapiroc@google.com> Tested-by: C Shapiro <shapiroc@google.com> Reviewed-by: C Shapiro <shapiroc@google.com>
